structured_output.summary: The change implements DataView.prototype.getInt16 as a thin wrapper that follows the three spec steps: `this` is taken as view, a missing littleEndian defaults to false, and the call is delegated to the shared `get_view_value` helper with ElementType::Int16. The new_target parameter is renamed to _new_target, which is needed because it is now unused. No special-casing, no made-up values, no swallowed errors. The correctness of the 13 GetViewValue steps (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex before ToBoolean, the detached/out-of-bounds TypeError, the RangeError bound, GetValueFromBuffer) rests on the helper in crate::support::typed_array, which is not in the diff and which I could not inspect. The gate reports 30 new passing tests with no regressions, which is consistent with the helper being correct.
